scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix mock-bse-api install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n mock,server,client -c cyan,green,magenta "npm --prefix mock-bse-api run dev" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n mock,server,client -c cyan,green,magenta "npm --prefix mock-bse-api start" "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run preview"
scripts.test: npm --prefix mock-bse-api test && npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix server run lint && npm --prefix client run lint
scripts.demo: cross-env MOCK_TOTAL_DELAY_MS=1500 PULL_BATCH_DELAY_MS=0 npm run dev
